title: Shadow Link
description: Make shadow items in minecraft without chunk suppressor. Controll it by GUI or Special Item!
body:
## 🌌 ShadowLink: Wireless Redstone & Item Remotes
**🌍 The first plugin in the world to implement shadow linking for mechanisms without requiring a chunk suppressor!**


**ShadowLink** is a high-performance wireless redstone plugin designed to eliminate the need for laggy chunk-suppressors. By utilizing a **Personalized Activation** system, every player can manage their own private network of mechanisms without interference. Whether you use custom-named items as remotes or the built-in GUI, ShadowLink provides a seamless, lag-free logic for remote activation.

---

### ⌨️ Command Variants
 **`/link_shadow by_item <channel_id>`**
* Links the target block to the item in your hand.
* The item becomes a private remote control tied to your UUID.
* Requires the item to have a custom name from an anvil.
* It will shown in gui

**`/link_shadow by_gui <channel_id>`**
* Registers the block to your personal virtual list for remote management.
* Enables activation via the GUI without requiring a physical item.


**`/shadow gui`**
* Opens your **Personal Shadow Hub** to manage all your links.
* Allows you to toggle channel states (Emerald/Redstone blocks) or delete channels.
* It will shown in gui but don't use item activation


**`/shadow <channel_id>`**
* Instantly toggles the specific channel state via a chat command.
* Ideal for fast execution or integration with other command plugins.


---

### 📜 Permissions
* **shadowlink.create**: Allows the player to use /link_shadow to create new links. (Default: true)
* **shadowlink.use**: Allows the player to use /shadow gui and direct toggle commands. (Default: true)


You can use it, just by mention it)
